clips.send: The gravity turn. Up first, then sideways. Rockets go straight up for the first few seconds to clear the tower and the thickest air. Then they tip a few degrees east, and gravity slowly bends the path over, so the rocket does not have to steer hard. Climbing straight up too long wastes fuel fighting gravity (“gravity loss”). Turning too early drags the rocket sideways through thick air (“drag loss”). Launching east from Florida adds about 0.4 km/s from Earth’s spin. Near the equator you get about 0.46 km/s. A gentle nudge, then let gravity steer. Rockets do not go “up to space and then stop”. Without sideways speed they fall straight back down.

clips.send: The rocket equation. Δv equals exhaust velocity times ln(m0 divided by m_f). Written down by Konstantin Tsiolkovsky in 1903. Δv is the total change in speed a rocket can make. It depends only on exhaust speed and the mass ratio: full mass m0 divided by empty mass m_f. Reaching low Earth orbit needs about 9.4 km/s of Δv (7.8 km/s of orbital speed plus about 1.5 km/s lost to gravity and drag). With exhaust velocity equals 3 km/s, getting 9.4 km/s from one stage would need m0 divided by m_f about 23: the rocket would have to be about 96 percent fuel. That is why real rockets use stages. More fuel helps less and less: the mass ratio sits inside a logarithm. Δv is not the top speed you will see. Gravity and drag eat part of it on the way up.

clips.send: Staging. Throw away what you no longer need. When a stage runs out of fuel, it drops off with its empty tanks and engines. The rest of the rocket no longer has to carry that dead weight. Saturn V had three stages; Falcon 9 and Long March 5 have two (plus side boosters on Long March 5). Engines on upper stages are designed for vacuum: hydrogen engines like the RL10 reach exhaust speeds of about 4.5 km/s. clips.send: 推力 等于 质量流量 乘 喷气速度。喷出多少质量、喷得多快。推力（牛顿） 等于 每秒喷出的质量（千克/秒） 乘 喷气速度（米/秒）。任何一个加倍，推力都加倍。工程师最喜欢高喷气速度，因为每千克燃料能提供更多推动。土星 5 号的一台 F-1 发动机每秒烧掉约 2.6 吨推进剂，喷气速度约 2.6 千米/秒：推力约 680 万牛顿。要起飞，推力必须大于火箭的重力。起飞时的推重比通常约为 1.2到1.5。推力 等于 喷多少 乘 喷多快。火焰大不一定发动机好。决定每千克燃料能把你送多远的是喷气速度，不是火焰大小。

clips.send: 火箭方程。Δv 等于 喷气速度 乘 ln(m0 除以 m_f)。康斯坦丁·齐奥尔科夫斯基在 1903 年写下了这个方程。Δv 是火箭能产生的总速度变化，只取决于喷气速度和质量比：满载质量 m0 除以 燃料烧完后的质量 m_f。进入近地轨道需要约 9.4 千米/秒的 Δv（7.8 千米/秒的轨道速度，加上约 1.5 千米/秒的重力和阻力损失）。如果 喷气速度 等于 3 千米/秒，单级要获得 9.4 千米/秒，需要 m0 除以 m_f 约等于 23：火箭约 百分之96 都得是燃料。所以真实的火箭都要分级。燃料越加越不划算：质量比被“关”在对数里。Δv 不等于你最后看到的速度。上升途中，重力和空气阻力会“吃掉”一部分。
clips.text: 火箭方程. Δv = vₑ × ln(m₀ ÷ m_f). 康斯坦丁·齐奥尔科夫斯基在 1903 年写下了这个方程。. Δv 是火箭能产生的总速度变化，只取决于喷气速度和质量比：满载质量 m₀ ÷ 燃料烧完后的质量 m_f。. 进入近地轨道需要约 9.4 千米/秒的 Δv（7.8 千米/秒的轨道速度，加上约 1.5 千米/秒的重力和阻力损失）。. 如果 vₑ = 3 千米/秒，单级要获得 9.4 千米/秒，需要 m₀ ÷ m_f ≈ 23：火箭约 96% 都得是燃料。所以真实的火箭都要分级。. 燃料越加越不划算：质量比被“关”在对数里。. Δv 不等于你最后看到的速度。上升途中，重力和空气阻力会“吃掉”一部分。
